items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Anyway we traveled around and he had Irma and he had Lester's little brother, Lee Young, he was a terrific dancer and singer and played drums.

ctx.x: He's originally from New Orleans. Yeah, originally from New Orleans.

That was the name of the band, the name of the outfit. He had a Varnabors short, it was a little company. He called it a stock company but anybody had their stock in it, I don't know anybody who ever got any dividends out of it. Anyway we traveled around and he had Irma and he had Lester's little brother, Lee Young, he was a terrific dancer and singer and played drums. And this girl Irma played a little trombone and sang and danced. And the old man played the saxophone and the piano. Whenever we get to a house…
